products.name: Manual High Pressure Ball Valves
products.description: AiraHigh Pressure Ball Valve is a quarter-turn shut-off valve specifically designed to control the flow of liquids and gases in high-pressure systems. It uses a precision-machined spherical ball with a central bore that rotates 90 degrees to open or close the flow path. Engineered for demanding industrial applications, these valves provide reliable, bubble-tight sealing, low operating torque, and long service life under extreme pressure and temperature conditions. Manufactured from high-strength materials such as stainless steel, carbon steel, or duplex stainless steel, high pressure ball valves are resistant to corrosion, wear, and mechanical stress. They are commonly fitted with PTFE, reinforced PTFE (RPTFE), PEEK, or metal seats to ensure dependable sealing and durability. Features such as a blow-out proof stem, anti-static design, and fire-safe construction further enhance operational safety and reliability. Common Applications Hydraulic systems Oil & gas pipelines Chemical processing plants High-pressure water systems Power plants Instrumentation systems Process industries

products.name: Pipeline Ball Valve
products.description: Aira Pipeline ball valve shall be a quarter-turn, full-port or reduced-port valve designed for reliable isolation of pipeline flow. The valve shall incorporate a precision-machined ball and stem arrangement to provide low-pressure-drop flow and tight shut-off. The valve body shall be suitable for the specified pipeline pressure and temperature conditions, with materials selected according to the service medium. The valve shall be suitable for manual, pneumatic, hydraulic, or electric actuation as required. The valve shall provide bubble-tight shut-off and shall be suitable for pipeline isolation, maintenance, emergency shutdown, and sectionalizing applications. Pipeline ball valves are primarily used for rapid and reliable isolation of pipeline flow. Typical applications include: Oil & gas pipelines – crude oil, natural gas, fuel and petroleum products Water pipelines – water transmission, distribution and utility systems Chemical pipelines – corrosive and non-corrosive process fluids Petrochemical plants – hydrocarbon and process-fluid isolation Power plants – cooling water, fuel, utility and process systems LNG and gas systems – natural gas and cryogenic services with suitable construction Steam and utility lines – where the selected valve materials and rating are suitable Pipeline sectionalizing – isolating sections of a pipeline for maintenance or emergencies Emergency shutdown (ESD) – when equipped with a suitable automatic actuator Compressor and pump stations – isolation of equipment and pipeline sections Main purpose: Pipeline ball valves are generally used for ON/OFF isolation, providing low flow resistance when fully open and tight shut-off when closed. They are normally not recommended for continuous throttling unless specifically designed for control service.

products.name: Linear Diaphragm Actuator
products.description: Airalinear diaphragm actuator is a pneumatic or hydraulic actuator that converts fluid pressure into linear (straight-line) mechanical motion. Description It typically consists of: Flexible diaphragm – separates the pressure chamber from the mechanical side. Actuator housing – contains and supports the diaphragm. Spring or return mechanism – returns the actuator to its normal position when pressure is removed. Stem/rod – transfers the diaphragm’s movement to the driven equipment. Working principle When compressed air or another fluid is introduced into the actuator chamber, pressure acts on the diaphragm and causes it to move linearly. This movement is transferred through the stem to operate a valve, damper, or other mechanism. When the pressure is reduced, a spring or opposing pressure returns the actuator. Applications Linear diaphragm actuators are commonly used for: Control valves Process automation Flow and pressure control HVAC dampers Chemical and industrial processing equipment Advantages: simple construction, reliable operation, good positioning capability, and relatively low maintenance.

products.description: AiraPneumatic Actuator 4-Way Ball Valve is an automated multi-port valve designed to divert, distribute, or mix the flow of liquids and gases in industrial piping systems. The valve combines a four-way ball valve with a pneumatic actuator, allowing remote and automatic operation using compressed air. By rotating the ball through 90°, the actuator changes the flow path between multiple ports, providing efficient control without manual intervention. The valve is equipped with four ports arranged to direct flow in various configurations, making it suitable for flow switching, media distribution, bypass systems, and process changeover applications. The pneumatic actuator may be supplied as double-acting for powered opening and closing or spring-return (fail-safe) to move the valve to a predefined safe position in the event of air supply failure. Typical Applications Chemical and petrochemical processing Oil and gas production Water and wastewater treatment Pharmaceutical manufacturing Food and beverage processing HVAC and utility systems Industrial automation and process control Mixing, diverting, and flow changeover systems Hydraulic and pneumatic fluid handling

products.name: Pneumatic Actuator Ball Valve Screwed End
products.description: AiraPneumatic Actuator Ball Valve – Screwed End is an automated quarter-turn valve designed to control the flow of liquids, gases, steam, and other process media using compressed air. The valve consists of a ball valve with threaded (screwed) end connections and a pneumatic actuator that enables fast, reliable, and remote operation without manual intervention. products.name: Pneumatic Jacketed Floating Ball Valve
products.description: AiraPneumatic Jacketed Floating Ball Valve is an automated quarter-turn valve designed to control the flow of fluids—especially high-viscosity, crystallizing, or temperature-sensitive media—while maintaining the required process temperature. Description The valve consists of a floating ball that is held between two valve seats and moves to open or close the flow passage. A pneumatic actuator operates the ball by converting compressed-air energy into rotary motion, typically through a 90° quarter turn. The jacketed body has an external heating or cooling chamber around the valve body. Steam, hot oil, thermal fluid, or another heating/cooling medium can circulate through the jacket to maintain the valve and process media at the desired temperature and prevent solidification, crystallization, or excessive viscosity. Key Features Floating ball design for reliable shut-off. Pneumatic actuation for fast and automatic operation. Full-bore or reduced-bore options depending on application. Jacketed body for heating or cooling. Suitable for high-viscosity and temperature-sensitive fluids. Available with single-acting or double-acting pneumatic actuators. Can be equipped with solenoid valves, limit switches, positioners, and other accessories. Commonly supplied with PTFE, reinforced PTFE, or other application-specific seats. Typical Applications Used in industries such as chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, food processing, polymer, resin, bitumen/asphalt, and oil & gas, particularly where the process medium must remain fluid during valve operation. In simple terms: it is a ball valve operated by compressed air, with a heated or cooled outer jacket that keeps the process fluid at the required temperature.

"AIRA" Offers Pneumatically Operated Diaphragm Valve Hermetically Seated Flow Path in the Body and Bonnet, Proper Selections of Diaphragm Provide, Precision Control of Critical of Ultra Pure Fluids. Fluids are Completely Isolated from the actuator and environment. Hygienic Design, Bi-directional Flow, Body for Low Turbulence. Also for Steam Sterilizing.Biotechnology, Ideally Suitable For Liquids, Highly Lustrous, Cosmetics Pharmaceutical Industries, Finish & Aesthetical Appearance, Food Industry Liquids Contaminated with Lubricants and Grit Particles. Viscous Liquids, Process Control Technology. Operating Principles The Diaphragm provides the body seal as well as the seat seal. There are no paths the outside environment an as such the valve is suitable for aseptic processes. As the valve is closed a pressure pad which supports the diaphragm moves towards the sealing face on the body. As the pressure plate moves the diaphragm flexes and is forced down onto the seal area in the center of the body thus closing off the flow path through the body. The inter - relationship of body to the pressure plate prevent over compression of the diaphragm. The valve can be actuated either manually or pneumatically and controlled by control tops and solenoid valves. Applications Diaphragm valves, manually or pneumatically operated, and specially design for use on hygienic and aseptic process in the pharmaceutical industries. The valves is excellent for flow control as well as for open / close duties.

products.name: 2inch Pneumatically Operated Angle Seat Valve
products.description: Angle seat valves are 2/2 way pneumatically actuated piston valves. The piston actuator provides a linear motion to lift the seal off its seat. Because the seat is positioned under an angle, the flow is minimally impeded in the open position, resulting in an excellent flow rate and a low pressure loss. They are used to regulate the flow of liquids, gases, steam, vacuum and even aggressive fluids. They can also operate with high temperatures and high viscosity media, even under zero differential pressures. The robust design makes angle seat valves a popular choice for harsh applications and they have very high cycle lives. Therefore, they are excellent long-life alternatives to ball valves. These valves are also suitable alternatives for solenoid valves, especially with contaminated, viscous media where typical solenoid valves would fail. They may be operated using a single acting or double acting configuration, which has an influence on its pressure rating.
